applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Matthew 1:20 was answered in named rounds, which is the situation K-G4 governs for counting such a verse as an unanswered witness.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: The phrase 'If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it' had two readings: (1) it forbids using an answered verse as an unanswered witness or broken-link count, which the judge does not do; (2) it could be read to require an express non-counting or quoting formula even for an underdetermined discussion, but the rule only governs counting as unanswered.
why: The judge states that challenger and defender answered on Matthew 1:20 and calls the point underdetermined, so it does not count the verse as an unanswered witness or toward a broken link.
